cn.t: Critics embrace this pop-fueled feminist reimagining of Shakespeare's tragedy as an exuberant, glittery spectacle. Max Martin's hits integrate smartly into the empowering narrative, though some find it lightweight. The joyous energy and strong performances win over most.
